ground_truth.title: Computer Science Internships for Students
ground_truth.main_content:
Internships and Apprenticeships

Find student-friendly opportunities where learners can apply computer science(CS) skills, explore careers, and gain insight into the tech industry.

Find internships and apprenticeships

JUMP TO SECTION

Apprenticeships

After High School

Apprenti

Technical training and year-long paid apprenticeships at tech companies for students looking for an alternative to college.

After High School

Multiverse

Paid CS apprenticeships at top companies and career development for students looking for an alternative to college.

After High School

NPower

Work-study program in select states for military veterans and students from underserved communities.

After High School

Year Up United

Year-long program includes six months of technical training and a six-month corporate internship.

Internships for students entering or in college

Entering/In College

InStep from Infosys

Internships across the globe with opportunities spanning artificial intelligence, sustainability, big data, and more.

Entering/In College

Microsoft Internships

Paid internship opportunities in fields like software engineering, UX design, data science, and more.

Internships for high school students

High School

Genesys Works

Year-long program for high school students includes technical training and a paid corporate internship.

High School

Microsoft High School Internships

On-the-job learning and opportunities to contribute to real-world technology projects at Microsoft.

Curriculum Catalog

Comprehensive curriculum offerings for every grade and experience level featuring robust structured and self-paced learning options.

Hour of AI
